tiktok.brief.title: Your next TikTok
tiktok.brief.subtitle: Use your own results to plan the next post. Your account can stay Personal.
tiktok.brief.days: Posts published in the last {days} days
tiktok.brief.note: These are current lifetime totals for posts published in this period, not views earned during it. Older posts have had more time to grow. Results include synced or imported data.
tiktok.brief.empty: Refresh TikTok or import its content export to compare your recent posts and plan a follow-up.
tiktok.toolkit.title: TikTok · Personal creator workflow
tiktok.toolkit.body: Prepare your script and caption, send the video to TikTok’s inbox, then add your sound and publish in TikTok.
tiktok.toolkit.results: Find your next idea from results
tiktok.toolkit.limits: Public comment automation needs a separate TikTok approval and is not connected here. Automatic TikTok DMs are unavailable for Personal accounts.
